research_question: How do the OCC national trust bank paths of Coinbase, Circle and Ripple compare, and what does the convergence imply for XRP custody, RLUSD/USDC reserves and institutional distribution?

regulatory_status_matrix.legal_bank_name: First National Digital Currency Bank, N.A.
scope_from_official_company_material: Circle's July 10 announcement says the national trust bank received final OCC approval.
The bank is intended to provide federally regulated fiduciary digital-asset custody for Circle and affiliates.
Reserve management for USDC is described as a future capability in the July 10 announcement.

Circle's current Circle National Trust page describes it as operating under OCC supervision and as a qualified custodian; at launch it is expected to operate primarily as a sub-custodian supporting services through Circle affiliates.
USDC and EURC continue to be issued by regulated Circle affiliates, not by the trust bank.
regulatory_status_matrix.operational_limit: The OCC CAS effective date establishes the charter transaction's consummated/effective status. It does not independently quantify client assets, custody balances or USDC reserve-management activity.

regulatory_status_matrix.operating_status: Charter transaction consummated/effective; separate operating launch date not established
regulatory_status_matrix.classification: OCC CAS primary record confirms consummated/effective date
scope_from_ripple_announcement: Act as collateral trustee of those reserves for RLUSD holders.
regulatory_status_matrix.issuer_boundary: Ripple says RLUSD continues to be issued by Standard Custody & Trust Company, Ripple's NYDFS-regulated limited-purpose trust company. The national trust bank does not replace the named issuer.
regulatory_status_matrix.bny_boundary: Ripple identifies BNY as RLUSD's primary reserve custodian. The precise operational division between BNY's custody role and RNTB's reserve-management/trustee role is not disclosed in the retrieved materials; do not assume one replaces the other.
regulatory_status_matrix.operational_limit: Ripple's announcement describes activities upon opening and says it will continue working with regulators as RNTB begins operations. No independently measured opening date, client assets or XRP-specific custody balances were found.

regulatory_status_matrix.classification: Preliminary conditional approval only; no Consummated/Effective action shown in OCC CAS at capture
scope_from_occ_decision_1370: Proposed fiduciary digital-asset custody primarily for institutional clients.
Related transactional services to accept, hold and transfer custodied fiat and digital assets, only for custody customers and only relating to custodied assets.
Plan to migrate the entirety of Coinbase Custody Trust Company's custody business from its NYDFS limited-purpose trust company to the national trust bank over a three-year de novo period.
Finder access for custody customers to affiliate staking, Prime Trading and Prime Financing; the bank itself would not provide those underlying services.
conditions_and_limits: The OCC decision is preliminary conditional approval, not authorization to commence business.
The bank must satisfy pre-opening requirements and receive final OCC approval before beginning business.
The proposed bank is not an insured depository institution and is restricted to trust-company operations and related activities.
The OCC decision specifies $60 million minimum Tier 1 capital for the first three years, with eligible-liquid-asset requirements and 180 days of operating expenses in eligible liquid assets.
regulatory_status_matrix.stablecoin_boundary: The OCC decision states that Coinbase National Trust Company does not propose to issue stablecoins. This trust-bank application is a custody/fiduciary and related-services proposal, not a Coinbase stablecoin issuer charter.

occ_active_list_scope_correction.observation: The OCC active trust-bank list as of September 30 includes First National Digital Currency Bank, N.A. Coinbase had no Consummated/Effective action in its CAS record at the November 2 capture.

competing_hypotheses.claim: Circle, Ripple and Coinbase are converging on federally supervised national trust-bank structures to reduce institutional custody and fiduciary-service friction.
competing_hypotheses.supporting_evidence: Circle and Ripple have OCC CAS consummated/effective dates; Coinbase has preliminary conditional approval for a custody-focused trust bank.
competing_hypotheses.disconfirming_or_limiting_evidence: Coinbase has not yet reached consummated/effective status in CAS; Circle/Ripple operating balances and client adoption are not disclosed by charter status alone.

competing_hypotheses.claim: Ripple's trust-bank charter and BNY's expanded custody support may lower institutional custody barriers for XRP.
competing_hypotheses.supporting_evidence: Ripple's approved business scope includes fiduciary digital-asset custody; BNY's October 27 announcement explicitly includes native XRP custody for eligible institutional clients.
competing_hypotheses.disconfirming_or_limiting_evidence: No XRP-specific custody balances, new institutional allocations, collateral use or incremental spot purchases are disclosed.

competing_hypotheses.claim: Circle and Ripple may compete for institutional stablecoin issuance, distribution, reserve and custody infrastructure while sharing BNY as a major custody provider.
competing_hypotheses.supporting_evidence: Both have effective national trust-bank paths; Coinbase distributes both USDC and RLUSD; BNY is named as primary reserve custodian for both stablecoin ecosystems in company materials.
competing_hypotheses.disconfirming_or_limiting_evidence: BNY's service roles do not establish shared reserves, common settlement, exclusivity or a coordinated strategy. Circle and Ripple reserve-management structures differ.

competing_hypotheses.claim: Coinbase's proposed trust bank could eventually broaden federally supervised institutional custody of XRP.
competing_hypotheses.supporting_evidence: The OCC decision authorizes the proposed custody business in principle and Coinbase already supports XRP custody/trading products in separate services.
competing_hypotheses.disconfirming_or_limiting_evidence: The national trust bank remains at preliminary conditional approval; no final/effective date, operational migration or asset-specific national-trust-bank custody schedule is disclosed.

feature_admission.circle_trust_bank_status: Categorical event series: preliminary conditional, final approval, CAS effective, operational launch, reserve-management commencement, custody assets.
feature_admission.ripple_trust_bank_status: Categorical event series: preliminary conditional, final approval announcement, OCC CAS effective, operating launch, reserve-management commencement, custody assets.
feature_admission.coinbase_trust_bank_status: Keep preliminary conditional approval separate from final approval, CAS effective and three-year custody migration milestones.
feature_admission.xrp_institutional_custody: Do not infer XRP AUC/A from bank charter status; require disclosed or onchain-reconciled XRP custody balances.
feature_admission.rlusd_reserve_management: Keep Standard Custody & Trust issuer, RNTB trustee/manager scope and BNY custodian role distinct until exact operational agreements are disclosed.
feature_admission.usdc_reserve_management: Circle National Trust's future reserve-management capability is not admitted as live solely from charter status.
feature_admission.xrp_spot_demand: No XRP purchase or price-direction feature is derived from OCC charter events alone.

forecast.reason: Trust-bank charter events are institutional/regulatory features, not synchronized XRP market flows. No calibrated out-of-sample relationship between these events and XRP returns has been demonstrated.

next_actions: Track Circle National Trust custody AUC/A, sub-custodian role and the date USDC reserve management actually transfers or commences.
Track Ripple National Trust Bank opening, OCC operational notices, reserve-management commencement and fiduciary XRP custody balances.
Track Coinbase National Trust Company's final approval, CAS consummated/effective date and start of the planned three-year custody migration.
Reconcile BNY's primary-custodian role with Circle and Ripple trust-bank reserve-management/trustee roles using later filings and agreements.
Test whether these regulatory milestones lead to measurable XRP custody balances, collateral acceptance or spot/ETF allocation changes; do not infer demand from charter status.
Keep XRP, RLUSD and USDC issuer, custody, reserve trustee, collateral and settlement roles as separate graph edges.
